attribution.note: Marcus's own words in his own Substack post, in his own voice.

semantics.note: The normalised claim matches the statement: an unqualified retrospective assertion that voice cloning has been used for mischief. Removing the start date was correct.

contract.note: The plain reading is fair and ordinary. One real deceptive incident between 2023 and the April 2024 post meets 'it has'. Deceptive election robocalls clearly count as mischief.

evidence.note: FCC forfeiture announcement, available 2024-09-26, before the cutoff. It documents January 2024 robocalls that used a cloned Biden voice to deter voters. This is an official record of an incident inside the window.
Pindrop's technical analysis, published 2024-01-25, finds the Biden robocall audio was a voice clone produced by text-to-speech. This backs up the synthesis element.

reviews.rationale: Two items together establish a real misuse before Marcus's 15 April 2024 post. The FCC record shows a cloned Biden voice was used in deceptive robocalls before New Hampshire's January 2024 primary. Pindrop's analysis confirms the audio was synthetic. The packet holds no counterevidence. The contract's support condition is met.
